map.把文本按 UTF-8 编码为字节序列后按所选变体编码。ASCII85：每 4 个: UTF-8 encode the text into bytes and encode with the chosen variant. ASCII85: combine every 4 bytes into a large integer (accumulate as value × 256 + current byte, and multiply by 256 to pad incomplete groups); when a full group has 4 effective bytes and value 0, output a single z character; otherwise repeatedly take value mod 85 plus 33 as a character and reverse to form 5 characters, finally taking only the first (effective bytes + 1); wrap the whole output with the start and end markers. The Z85 variant uses a different alphabet and grouping rule.
